base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key B minor, 104 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: Two-bar melodic motif in B natural minor (4/4 time): Bar 1 begins on the pickup 'and' of beat 4 with scale degree 5 (F#4), leaping up to tonic 1 (B4) on beat 1. On beat 2-and, it steps down through 7 (A4) to flat-6 (G4), held with a gentle dip over beat 3 before releasing to 5 (F#4) on beat 4. Bar 2 enters on beat 2 with flat-3 (D4) stepping up to 4 (E4), then resolving to lower tonic 1 (B3) on beat 3 with a breathy fall, phrased across open Turkish vowels on the lyric 'Hangi cilt tutar sökülen yeri'..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: Sparse upright piano playing an ostinato in octaves around B2-B3 with delicate fingerpicked nylon-string guitar outlines. Soft vinyl dust crackle and subtle mechanical wood-creak Foley in the stereo field.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: A dry, unadorned close-mic kick drum on beats 1 and 3 with an acoustic rim click on beat 4. An organic upright bass enters with smooth legato walking lines between B1 and E2. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar keeps the pulse steady.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: Muted electric rhythm guitar enters with palm-muted eighth notes. Kick doubles to a pulsing heartbeat pattern while a bowed double bass swells beneath to lift tension toward the chorus.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: Full acoustic guitar strumming across the stereo spread, crisp live snare on 2 and 4 with vintage plate reverb. Clean Fender Telecaster plays the melodic hook in thirds, mirrored by the bass locking tightly to the kick drum.
timeline.chords: Bm - Gmaj7 - D - A/C# - Em7 - F#m7 - Bm

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: Drums strip down to rim click and hi-hat; electric guitar rings out its final sustained B note over gentle piano arpeggios, resetting the intimate workshop room ambiance.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: Kick and rim pattern resumes with subtle sixteenth-note brushed snare shuffles. Bass introduces descending chromatic passing tones, while an ambient slide guitar adds subtle, weeping harmonic swells in the background.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: Building tom-tom accents join the palm-muted electric guitar. Bass climbs aggressively up to the octave, and an analog mono synth pad opens its low-pass filter to expand the sonic ceiling.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Driving open acoustic strumming, full kit with open hi-hat slosh on offbeats, wide dual-tracked electric guitars playing rhythmic stabs, and upright piano hammering quarter-note chord roots.
timeline.chords: Bm - Gmaj7 - D - A/C# - Em7 - F#m7 - Bm

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: Drums abruptly pull out, leaving a solitary, slightly detuned upright piano and bowed double bass playing a modal C#m7b5 to F#7b9 progression. Vocal takes front stage with intimate dryness before a rising snare roll re-engages the groove.
timeline.chords: Em9 - Dmaj7 - C#m7b5 - F#7b9 - Gmaj7 - Em7 - F#7sus4

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: Peak dynamic bloom without synthetic excess: full live kit playing driving backbeat, layered 12-string acoustic guitars, soaring Telecaster hook, and rich vocal double-tracking on the title hook line.
timeline.chords: Bm - Gmaj7 - D - A/C# - Em7 - F#m7 - Gmaj7 - A - Bm

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: Kit fades rapidly leaving only fingerpicked acoustic guitar, decaying piano chords, and a final, lingering Bm(add9) natural harmonic on the bass as the mechanical clockwork texture of the room softly dissipates.
